items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: Yeah, well she told Dick about that.

ctx.x: Yeah, well Dick, cause Dick told... Maybe that's right.

Cause she told Dick about when I, when we was playing at the Crystal Palace everybody would bring me a beer and give it to him and when they bring him ice cream he'd give it to me. Oh yeah, you told us that too. Yeah, well she told Dick about that. Yeah.
And then I guess Dick I forgot. I don't hear those other interviews and we get so many of them sometime I don't know.
